lines: Financial data confirmed from SEC EDGAR earnings releases (T1 sources). Five-year trajectory with CAGR analysis. Revenue labels corrected from entity profile: FY2025 data from Q4 2025 earnings release (SEC, filed Jan 28, 2026).
¹ FY2025 total revenues $1,003M confirmed from Q4 2025 SEC earnings release (Jan 28, 2026). Highest in 5 years. [T1]
² FY2024 FFO includes $216.1M ($3.08/share) one-time debt extinguishment gains [E-019]
³ FY2025 FFO includes $57.2M ($0.75/share) debt extinguishment gains [SEC FY2025 earnings]

Revenue Trend: VARIABLE-TO-RECOVERING. Decline FY2022→FY2024 reflects $8B+ deliberate portfolio dispositions. FY2025 recovery to $1,003M driven by: (1) One Madison full-year contribution, (2) GLS CMBS securitization income ($62.7M new in FY2025), (3) strong leasing velocity. Normalized FFO stable ~$5.00/share across 3 years. SUMMIT trajectory ACCELERATING (23.4% 3yr CAGR) then slight FY2025 moderation — Paris 2027 is next growth catalyst.
Trend: VARIABLE (office declining) + SUMMIT ACCELERATING + GLS/CMBS EMERGING

The five-year revenue trajectory reflects a deliberate strategic pivot, not operational decline. SLG disposed $8B+ of assets between 2021 and 2025 to concentrate on trophy Manhattan buildings commanding record rents. This reduced portfolio sq ft but lifted per-sq-ft metrics to all-time highs: $56/sqft average starting rent, 8.5% above prior fully-escalated rents in FY2024. [E-007, E-019]

FY2025 revenue recovered to $1,003M — the highest in five years — driven by: (1) One Madison full-year contribution, (2) GLS CMBS special servicing fee income ($62.7M in FY2025 vs $19M in FY2024), and (3) strong rental recovery from record leasing activity. This revenue mix shift toward recurring fee income is the execution of strategic objective SO-02. [SEC Q4 2025 earnings, T1]

SUMMIT inflection point: Revenue grew from near-zero (Oct 2021) to $133.2M (FY2024) at 23.4% 3yr CAGR, before a slight decline to $122.3M in FY2025 reflecting NYC tourism patterns. Paris 2027 is the next growth catalyst. Without marketing automation (VG-03 CONFIRMED) and a visitor CRM, SUMMIT cannot drive repeat visitation, pre-launch demand generation, or global audience acquisition at scale. This is the most tangible Marketing Cloud use case in the portfolio. [E-087]

Normalized FFO: Both FY2024 ($3.08/share gains) and FY2025 ($0.75/share gains) included one-time debt extinguishment gains. Normalized FFO is stable: FY2023 $4.94 → FY2024 $5.03 → FY2025 $4.97 → FY2026 guidance $4.40–$4.70. Reflects steady execution within a capital-recycling strategy. FY2026 guidance dilution reflects One Madison stabilization costs and casino license write-off. [E-086]

Legal Structure: SL Green Realty Corp. is a fully integrated, self-managed real estate investment trust (REIT) organized under the laws of the state of Maryland, incorporated in 1980 and publicly listed on the New York Stock Exchange under ticker SLG since 1997. [E-009] The company operates as Manhattan's largest office landlord, with its principal executive offices at One Vanderbilt Avenue, New York, NY 10017.

The self-managed REIT structure is directly relevant to Zennify's engagement model: all technology procurement — CRM, ESG platforms, and operations systems — is an internal corporate decision, not delegated to a third-party property manager. Technology investments must demonstrate clear operational ROI within the REIT's disciplined capital allocation framework (mandatory 90%+ taxable income distribution requirement).
